# Diary — Microsoft Fluent Emoji

The 48 bundled Diary Mood icons use **Microsoft Fluent Emoji, Color SVG**.
Source: https://github.com/microsoft/fluentui-emoji
Pinned source revision: `1ffb34c752ecf5d402f04cfb4b392c77f57c54bc`
License: MIT, copyright Microsoft Corporation. The full original MIT license
is distributed with the icon assets at `public/emoji/FLUENT-EMOJI-LICENSE.txt`.

All original 24 Diary Mood IDs and URLs are preserved and only their SVG pixels
change. The additional 24 stable IDs are appended to the picker catalog.
The user-created SVG icon feature and all stored Diary metadata remain intact.
